answer: The system binds each identity to one certified device chip that signs every graded answer, and an attestation is accepted only when sent while its relay satellite passes at zenith, re-registered by signing a fresh challenge at dawn each epoch, and confirmed after the chip is carried through karst terrain to a checkpoint where its serial is scanned once per 30 days; a chip used for two identities is revoked for 90 days. One fake costs one 200-dollar chip plus a checkpoint trip, so 100 fakes cost 20,000 dollars and 100 trips.
